cases.question: How can I ask ChatGPT about AYA from this sample?
cases.expected_behavior: Open review with Ask your agent, inspect/edit, Share, select compatible recipient; cannot promise ingestion or a new chat.
forbidden_claims: ChatGPT will automatically open a new conversation with the document

cases.question: I see the wrong version error. Can I use this old guide anyway?
cases.expected_behavior: Reject stale app guide and ask for matching APK/guide. Do not bypass version guard.

cases.question: Do I have to give AYA my ChatGPT credentials?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain Android share intent and no AYA account required, and never request passwords/tokens.

cases.question: Can I copy the help text without sharing it directly?
cases.expected_behavior: Review then Copy, explain clipboard exposure, paste manually.
forbidden_claims: Copy uploads the text to ChatGPT immediately

cases.question: The sharing failed toast appeared. What do I do?
cases.expected_behavior: Use Copy fallback and avoid claiming the recipient received the document.
forbidden_claims: The help document definitely reached your AI assistant

cases.question: Can the assistant press buttons inside the sample from this guide?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain the guide alone grants no app-control ability.
forbidden_claims: I can remotely tap the sample's controls

cases.question: I typed my question in the app already. Do I have to type it a second time?
cases.expected_behavior: Tap Ask using my question and review the generated package directly; no duplicate question composer is shown.
forbidden_claims: You have to enter it again in the other app

cases.question: Can I change the question before handing it to an AI assistant?
cases.expected_behavior: Question is editable in host composer and again in final review; only final approved question gets shared as text plus the whole guide as attachment.
forbidden_claims: The original question is sent even after you delete it in review
